bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖反弹收复 $262–266

read.en: Teradyne rose 3.2% on Nov 3 to $269.35, trading between $266.43 and $274.10. It is below the falling 5-day ($282.8), 10-day ($301.0), 30-day ($360.2) and 100-day ($372.9) averages and the rising 200-day ($349.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($300.64), and RSI is 30, near oversold.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 11月3日上涨 3.2%，收于 $269.35，盘中区间 $266.43–274.10。股价位于下行的 5 日（$282.8）、10 日（$301.0）、30 日（$360.2）和 100 日均线（$372.9）以及上行的 200 日均线（$349.9）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$300.64），RSI 为 30，接近超卖。

read.en: The bounce reclaimed the $262.3–266.4 resistance (Feb–Mar and Oct 30 lows), now support; the $274.1 high stalled at $273.1–278. Resistance is $273.1–278 (Mar 30 low, Nov 2 and 3 highs), then $282.8–288.7 (5-day, Oct 30 high, Oct 29 low) and $295–300.6. Support is $262.3–266.4, then $257.8 and $246.8 (Feb 3 low). A close above $278 would target $283–289; below $262, $258.

r.en: Mar 30 low $273.1; Nov 3 high $274.1; Nov 2 high $278.0
Oct 28 low $295; Jul 17 low $296.8; Parabolic SAR $300.6

s.en: Oct 30 and Nov 3 lows ($266.4); Mar 9 low $263.0; Feb 4–5 lows ($262.3–263.2), reclaimed
